text: I can explain the difference between a monolith, a modular monolith and a distributed monolith.
I can list the benefits of microservices and say which ones are organisational.
I can name four costs of microservices: latency, partial failure, distributed data and observability.
I can explain Conway's law and use it to argue for or against a service split.
I can say when I would not use microservices, and describe the strangler fig path for splitting later.
